svg.text: DIEGETIC KIT · THE RAID, BEFORE AND AFTER
same corridor, same torch, same goblet
17 HUD elements → the world, the hands, the Lair
the world and the hands say it
Torch colour: the fires go red
Leave the raid: Lair ledger, strongbox, portal pile
Grimoire: hold Tab, spell word written large
Palm glow: lapis light, size is loudness
Pocket watch: hold T, ring of light empties
Nothing else is drawn on the screen in the proposed frame. Letters rising from the palm are the cast line, in the world.
